position_in_range.meaning: position's true In-Range status (underlying price close to strike)

fee_charged_high.meaning: force exercise fee charged equals the high FORCE_EXERCISE_COST (~1.024% of notional)

fee_charged_nominal.meaning: force exercise fee charged equals the nominal ONE_BPS (~0.01% of notional)

current_tick_manipulated.meaning: currentTick (instantaneous Uniswap spot) has been atomically manipulated via flash swap

within_safe_mode.meaning: tick deviation stays within protocol Safe Mode thresholds (MAX_TICKS_DELTA)

assumptions: The attacker can perform the manipulate-forceExercise-reverse sequence atomically in a single transaction (as_atomic_sandwich).
The victim position was genuinely In-Range before manipulation, so the true In-Range status is true.
The attacker is permissionlessly able to call PanopticPool.forceExercise().

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the exact numeric relationship between tick deviation and MAX_TICKS_DELTA, so the Safe Mode threshold bound cannot be encoded as a numeric comparison.

Report gives fee magnitudes only as approximate percentages (~1.024% and ~0.01% of notional) without a defined notional symbol or exact integer amounts, so fee values are represented as grounded Boolean outcomes rather than numeric comparisons.

limitations: Only the direct fee-evasion impact (i_fee_evasion) is formalized; i_yield_theft and i_invariant_bypass are deferred to future claims.
The condition narrows to the manipulated-tick subcase because the report establishes the manipulation scenario; the general requirement is that the fee reflect true In-Range status.
Fee amounts are encoded as Boolean high/nominal outcomes because the report provides only approximate percentages without a defined notional quantity.
Runtime binding of currentTick manipulation and Safe Mode threshold to concrete code is deferred.
